proposals.before: Only Song Gui and Pan Shouheng were fairly able to remonstrate with the Xuande and Aizong emperors and at times were of benefit — outstanding among hirelings, ringing like iron.
proposals.after: Only Song Gui and Pan Shouheng were fairly able to remonstrate with the Xuanzong and Aizong emperors and at times were of benefit — outstanding among hirelings, ringing like iron.
proposals.reason: Chinese 宣、哀 refers to Xuanzong and Aizong; Xuande is a different reign name and mistranslates 宣.

proposals.before: When Guannu went to Bo Prefecture, Gui secretly joined the palace attendant Wugusun Aishi, Nalan Geda, the guardswoman Xilie Wanchu, Fan Chenseng, Wang Shan'er, and others in a plot to kill him.
proposals.after: When Guannu went to Bo Prefecture, Gui secretly joined the palace attendant Wugusun Aishi, Nalan Geda, the guard Xilie Wanchu, Fan Chenseng, Wang Shan'er, and others in a plot to kill him.
proposals.reason: 女奚烈 is a Jurchen surname, not the word woman; 護衛 marks the office of guard. Rendering Xilie Wanchu as guardswoman invents sex from a surname.

proposals.reason: Same surname/office error as in the idiomatic line: 女奚烈完出 is the personal name of a guard, not a guardswoman.

decisions.reason: s0009 has 諷諫宣、哀, abbreviating Jin temple names 宣宗 and 哀宗; Xuande is a different era name and wrongly renders 宣, while Xuanzong matches the Chinese and the parallel idiomatic line.
護衛女奚烈完出 names a 護衛 (guard) whose Jurchen surname is 女奚烈; the 女 is part of the clan name, not 'woman', so 'guardswoman' invents sex and 'the guard' is the accurate repair.
The same 護衛女奚烈完出 parsing applies to the literal: office 護衛 plus personal name 女奚烈完出, so replacing 'guardswoman' with 'guard' corrects the invented sex.
